components.description: Accessible trainer search field; native selects share its surface and border treatment.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Inherited active shell navigation; the mobile inset indicator runs along its bottom edge.

components.name: Trainer Card
components.description: Linked library card. The source's real initial fallback is shown instead of introducing an image asset or fictional trainer record.

components.name: Trainer Disclosure
components.description: Native in-flow details/summary with the existing fallback portrait and rotating CSS chevron. Preview represents the disclosure shell only.
components.html:
?Choose a trainer…
Search and labelled origin, region and game filters precede trainer choices.
components.css: .ds-picker{border:1px solid var(--line,#433536);border-radius:.6rem;color:var(--ink,#ece1e2);font:13.5px/1.5 var(--hoard-font-sans,'Source Sans 3',sans-serif)}.ds-picker-summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.65rem;padding:.5rem;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-picker-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-picker-summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#e2404f);outline-offset:1px}.ds-picker-name{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-picker-summary::after{content:'';width:.5rem;height:.5rem;margin:0 .5rem;border-right:1px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-picker[open]>.ds-picker-summary::after{transform:rotate(225deg)}.ds-picker-avatar{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;font-size:18.24px;font-weight:800;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent-soft,rgba(226,64,79,.14));color:var(--accent,#e2404f)}.ds-picker-body{padding:.65rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#433536)}

components.name: Library Error and Retry
components.description: Inherited accessible ErrorBox used for catalog and saved-library failures; demonstration message only.
components.css: .ds-error{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger,#c4463a) 45%,transparent);border-radius:var(--hoard-radius,8px);padding:8px 12px;font:13px/1.5 var(--hoard-font-sans,'Source Sans 3',sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#ece1e2);background:var(--danger-bg,color-mix(in srgb,#c4463a 14%,transparent))}.ds-retry{background:none;border:0;padding:0;color:var(--accent,#e2404f);font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-retry:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-retry:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#e2404f);outline-offset:1px}

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive scan of the existing implementation, not a newly approved metaphor or replacement identity. Warm, dark brown surfaces, a crimson accent, serif page headings and compact sans-serif controls frame trainer portraits and Pokémon team strips. The interface uses dense, labelled controls and restrained borders to support selecting and managing trainers.

The documented change is limited to the shared visual trainer picker and saved trainer library. The surrounding shell, theme, assets and other screens remain inherited. Sources are `client/src/hoard-theme.css` (the `silver` palette), `client/src/index.css`, `client/src/app.css`, `client/src/components/silver.jsx` and `client/src/pages/Entrenadores.jsx`; the supplied desktop/mobile captures confirm the incumbent appearance. This scan does not establish new product strategy or claim an approved visual comp.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark surfaces with a single crimson action accent.
Serif page headings paired with compact sans-serif labels.
Trainer portraits and team sprites beside readable names.
Native disclosure and select controls with wrapping filter rows.
dos: Do reuse the inherited Silver palette and shared type stacks.
Do keep trainer portraits, names and team strips together in selection and library views.
Do retain labelled native selects, keyboard disclosure behavior and visible focus.
Do keep catalog failures actionable through an alert and Retry.
donts: Don't infer a translated UI label from a saved trainer's name or overwrite names as part of UI localization.
Don't treat this focused scan as a redesign of inherited screens or completion of tasks #640 and #641.
Don't replace the established pixel portraits or warm dark/crimson identity during narrow refinements.
